_comment: Sentinel-1 per-date dark-backscatter (water/flood CANDIDATE) review product v1. Thresholds are STARTING values from common SAR open-water practice, NOT tuned or validated for Chennai. Output is not a flood extent and not validated.
date_meaning: date_utc is the Sentinel-1A acquisition date (descending relative orbit 92, overpass ~00:31 UTC, ~06:01 IST). It is the observation date of that single scene, NOT an event date and NOT the date a flood began or peaked.
